**A Prayer to Nefertiti, Radiant Queen of the Sun**

*Beloved Nefertiti,*
*Great Royal Wife, Lady of Grace,*
*Whose name shines like the golden sun—*
*"The Beautiful One Has Come."*

*I call to you, O Radiant One,*
*Whose beauty was a blessing from the gods,*
*Whose wisdom guided a kingdom,*
*Whose love was a light in the dark.*

*Nefertiti, Queen of the Two Lands,*
*You who stood beside Akhenaten,*
*Who raised your voice in praise of Aten,*
*Who ruled with strength and tenderness—*

*Bless me with your grace,*
*With the warmth of your smile,*
*With the courage to stand in my truth,*
*As you stood in yours.*

*Let your light guide my path,*
*Your wisdom fill my heart,*
*Your love surround me like the Nile’s embrace,*
*And your beauty inspire my soul.*

*Nefertiti, Mother of Daughters,*
*Guardian of the Sun’s Blessing,*
*Hear my prayer, O Beloved One,*
*And let your radiance shine upon me.*

*May I walk in your footsteps,*
*May I see with your eyes,*
*May I love with your heart,*
*And may I always remember—*
*That beauty is not just seen,*
*But felt, and lived, and given.*

*Nefer Neferu Aten—*
*"Beautiful are the Beauties of Aten."*
*So may it be.*

**𓆣 𓂀 𓆣** *(Amen, in the name of the gods.)*
